content: Jesús, ibmar-gwag-diglegedgi burbar sunmaksad
Jesús gannar Galilea-mata-dummad-gaka-naba-sii emar-odurdakdebalid. Dulemar-bukidar ese ambikunonisoggu, Jesús ur-naidgi nakwisad. Dulemardi, gakagi ambikusmalad.
Geb degine, Jesús urgi sii, bukidar ibmar-burbamaladgi dulemar-odurdakded. Ega sogded:
“Bemar nue itomar: Ibagwengine, dule-wargwen-ibmar-gwag-digedi ibmar-gwag dignaded.
Digega ibmar-gwag-bikin-midgua, abar ibmar-gwag igargi babatidapid. Sikwimar nonigua, a-ibmar-gwag guchad.
Abar akwa-yaisulidgi, napa-asginegwadgi babatismalad. Agi gwae-gwae ibmar-gwag ainialid, ar ade, napa-asginegwad.
Ar dad gaargudii, ibmar-gwag gummakded, ar e-maligan asgin-nikasoggu, dinguded.
Baid-ibmar-gwag iko-abargi babatisad. Ikomar dungudgua, bur bule ibmar-gwag-birgi obited, degisoggu, ibmar-gwag gwen sanmaksasulid.
Bamalad-ibmar-gwagdi, napa-nuedgi babatisad. Ainided, dunguded, geb nue sanmaksad. Gwenna-gwenna akusaar sanmaksad, abala bur-nuegwad sanmaksad, baigandi bur bule sanmaksad.”
Jesús sogdebalid: “Bemar mag nue-itobiele, nue-itomar.”
Jesús ibiga burbar sunmakdedae
Sorbali, Jesús walagwen besgua, e-sapingan-e-ambe-gakabogwad (12), degi, dulemar-e-walik-bukmalad, Jesúsʼse egichiarmalad, burbar-sunmakleged wede, ibi obarye.
Jesús, abin-sogded: “Ar bemargardi, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid-igar-burbar-mamaid osanolesad. Ar dulemar-baigangardi, unnila burbale an odurdaked,

content.text: adi, dulemar ise-dakar imakmar-inigwele, mer mag dakmalaga,
degi, Bab-Dummad mer e-isgued ega eliegar.”

content: Isaías 6:9-10
Jesús ibmar-gwag-digedgi-burbar-sunmaksad odulosad
Jesús e-sapinganga sogdebalid: “Burbar an ibmar-sogsad, ¿bemar aku-itomala? Degite, ¿igi bemar ibmar-baigan-burbaled magar itomalosunna?
”Dule-ibmar-gwag-digedi, dule-Bab-Dummad-gayaburbagi-sunmaked-e-wilub gued.

”Abar-dulemar ibmar-gwag-igarba-babatismaladyob gued. Amar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba itosmalad. Itosad-sorbali, nia-saila-Satanás danidaed. Geb e-gwagegi Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nued-diglesad ei ungenonidaed.
”Bamalad ibmar-gwag-akwa-yaisulidgi-babatismaladyob gued. Amar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba itomalad, degi, nue-weligwaledgi abingamalad.
Ar wemar unnila asginbi Bab-Dummad-abingasmarsoggu, unnila sikwas Bab-Dummadba nagumalad. Ar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-ular-wilearmargu, degi, dulemar sabsur-e-imakarmargu, Bab-Dummadgi bangudmalad.
”Bamalad ibmar-gwag-iko-imbaba-babatismaladyob gued. Amar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba itosmalad.

Ar we-napneggi ibmarba bukib-binsaed, maniginbi bur binsaed, degi, bela-ibmar-nikubied, e-gwagegi dognonigu, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-e-gwagegi-naid iedmarsunnad. Degisoggu, amar ibmar-gwag-gwen-sanmaksasulidyob gunonisunnad.

”Ar bamaladdi ibmar-gwag-napa-nuedgi-babatismaladyob gued. Amar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba itosmalad, e-gwagegi nue-abingasmalad. Degisoggu, amar ibmar-gwag napa-nuedgi diglesadyob gued. Gwenna-gwenna akusaar sanmaksad, abala bur-nuegwad sanmaksad, deginbali, baigandi bur-napiragwad sanmaksad.”
Ibmar-dukualed sanar onolegedsegad
A-sorbali, Jesús sogdebalid: “¿Ar gwallu mese-urba-siega, igi, gabed-urba-siegardibe ogalesi? Suli, gwallu neg-mee-saega niba sileged.
Deyobi, ibmar bipisaale gwen dukuosurguoed. Deginbali, ibmar-dukuar-imakleged bela wisgulegedsegad.
Bemar mag nue-itobiele, nue-itomar.”
Jesús sogdebalid: “Nue itomalo, ar igi bemar dulemarga ibmar-mergu-uke, deyobi Bab-Dummad bemarga ibmar-mergu ukmogoed, degi, bur bule-mergu bemarga ukbaloed.
Ar dule-ibmar-nikadga, aka bur bule ega ibmar uklebaloed. Ar dule-ibmar-sateddina, amba wis-bipi-ibmar-nikadse-bakale, e-ibe sulegoed.”
Jesús, ibmar-gwag-niedgi burbar sunmaksad
Jesús sogdebalid: “Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid weyobid, dule-gwensak ibmar-gwag napagi digedyobid.
Baisulid, we-dule gabmaidibe, atakdidibe, mutikidbadibe, neg-ibginedbadibe, gusgu ibmar-gwag na e-itolegedba ainied. We-dule aku-itoged ibiga nabir ibmar-gwag dunguar dae.
Ar napade, ibmar-gwag nabir dunguega imaked. Gebesaila, e-gagan-inse aramakdagoed, a-sorba, durbamakdagoed, geb agine, sanmakdagoed.
Geb ibmar-gwag nue goresale, geb weledagoed, ar ade weleged-ibagan warmaksad.”
Jesús, mostaza-e-gwaggi burbar sunmaksad
Jesús sogdebalid: “¿Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid ibiyob gue? Anmar egi sunmakega, ¿Ibu burbar-sunmakleged anmar sunna ebusale?
”Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid, ar mostaza-e-gwag-napagi-diglesayob gued. Ar mostaza-e-gwag bur ibmar-gwag-bamaladba bipii gue-inigwele,
ar dunguderdi, ibmar-dubaled-masga-gued-birgi bur dumma naddaed. E-anagan-dummagan nikuddaed, degisoggu, sunna sikwimar e-anagan-urba, negsichigwadgi obunnomalad.”
Dulemar-magar-e-itogedse, weyobi Jesús burbar-sunmakale, Bab-gayaburbagi dulemar-odurdakdaed.
Jesús dulemar-odurdakdele, burbar-sunmaksuli geg dulemar-odurdakdaed. Ar e-sapingangardi bachikii bela ega osanalodaed.
Jesús, burwa, degi, demar obogilesad
A-ibagi, neg-sedodgusgu, Jesús e-sapinganga sogded: —Anmar mata-dummad-abin-obakar namala.
Geb dulemar-idu nadmalad, degi, Jesús-urgi-siidgi e-sapingan eba nadmalad. Dule-baigan ur-baidgangi eba nadmarmogad.
Geb degine, mataba egi burwa-dummad noalid. Burwa binnasursoggu, demar-arwedba ur dogedgualid.
Jesúsʼdi ursorba nono-onakwed-birgi nono-onakwiis gabmaid. Degisoggu, e-sapingan Jesús-odaksamalad, ega sogdemalad: —Odurdaked-saila, ¿baisur be anmar-dake anmar burgwisar?
Geb Jesús gwisgusgu, burwaga sabsur ibmar sogsad, degi, demarga sogded: “Be bogidik gue.” Geb burwa bogidik naded, bela neg bogidik sigisad.
Geb Jesús e-sapinganga sogded: —¿Ibiga bemar yaisur dobgue? ¿Ar bemar amba Bab-Dummad-benmala?
Jesús-e-sapingan bela nue-dobe itodmalad, degi, na muchub-muchub sognanai guarmalad: —¿Wede doa-dulesunna, burwase-bakar, degi, demarse-bakar, eba ibsamargu?
